verdicts.reason: Both break the product badge: the cream circle has come off the bottle and sits clipped in the bottom-left corner, and the bottle is left as a thin outline floating above it, so the key image is destroyed. A also pushes 'Out now.' about 90px below the headline, leaving a gap that splits the copy group, and sets the CTA at a height that lines up with neither line. B keeps the headline and subline together and puts the CTA on the headline's axis, though the CTA sits close to the right edge and the lower third is dead space.
